packageRules.description: @uniswap/token-lists 1.0.0-beta.35 was published with a broken tarball (no dist/ directory in the published package). Pin to beta.34 until upstream republishes.

react-scripts 5 (Create React App) is archived and uses an old `resolve` package that does not understand the modern `exports` field. TypeScript 7 dropped the top-level `main` field from its package.json, which breaks `react-scripts` builds. Stay on the 5.x line until the project migrates off react-scripts.

Watch `braces` for a release that fixes GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (CVE-2026-93687, stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested patterns). Dependabot alert #238 cannot be resolved until upstream ships a patched version. Until then this rule ensures a PR is opened the moment one is published.
